messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.name: movie_details_brief
function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extra_info.description: Option to get additional information like Director, Cast, Awards etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants a brief about the movie "全面啟動" (which is "Inception") and then retrieve extra info like director, cast, awards for Inception, and also for "黑暗騎士" (The Dark Knight). The function movie_details_brief can retrieve brief or extra info. We need to call it twice: once for Inception with extra_info true, and once for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. The function signature: title: string, extra_info?: boolean. So we should call twice.

We need to output the brief first, then the extra info. But the brief is part of the same function? The function returns details. We can call with extra_info false to get brief. Then call with true to get extra info. Or maybe the function returns both? It says "brief about a specified movie". Option to get additional info. So if extra_info true, it returns brief plus extra. If false, just brief. So we can call twice: one with false, one with true. But we might combine? The user wants brief first, then extra info. So we can call twice.

Thus we need two calls:

1. movie_details_brief({"title":"全面啟動","extra_info":false})
2. movie_details_brief({"title":"全面啟動","extra_info":true})
3. movie_details_brief({"title":"黑暗騎士","extra_info":true})

But we might combine Inception calls into one? The user wants brief then extra info. We could call with extra_info true and then separate the brief from the extra info. But easier to call twice.

We need to produce JSON calls. We'll do three calls.
